''See also: [[Gray Island Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Gray [[Island]] is a mysterious and highly fortified location situated in the [[Aion Sea]], north and east of other known territories. It is famously characterized by Bastion's Veil{{!}}Bastion’s Veil, a permanent and impenetrable wall of [[silver mist]] or fog that surrounds the land. This shroud is so unique that Alchemists{{!}}alchemists in the [[Guild]] have been unable to replicate it in laboratory settings. The island's appearance is deceptive; while it often looks like a pristine, untamed wilderness filled with rolling green hills, dense forests, and an [[Imperial]] Park-like landscape, it is actually a densely populated hub of activity. This outward simplicity reflects an [[Am’haranai]] philosophy of being humble in appearance while remaining complex internally. The island serves as the headquarters for the Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild and is home to approximately two thousand [[Consultants]], including over five hundred students. It functions as a center for various specialized groups, such as the [[Masons]], [[Architects]], [[Miners]], and [[Gardeners]]. Beyond its role as a professional hub, the Gray [[Island]] is a place of extreme danger and secrecy, filled with hidden trails, tunnels, catacombs, and deadly traps. It contains concealed high-status prisons and vast underground chambers that resemble massive arenas. Because of its many layers of deception, it is difficult to navigate and easy to lose oneself within. While once a secure independent retreat, the island has been the site of significant conflict and was eventually seized by [[Imperial]] forces, leading to ongoing efforts to reclaim it.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Located to the north and east, Gray [[Island]] is a land perpetually hidden behind an impenetrable wall of mist. This location, which features a long [[stone]] dock and a forest, served as the site for the original [[Imperial]] Prison built off the coast of [[Aurelia]]. While Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius intends for the group to wait there, [[Calder]] is tasked with heading toward the island, where the [[Consultants]] are believed to be located. The terrain contains a chapter house deeper within its borders and an arena situated underneath the island, all of which possess an [[aura]] that can be [[Read]]. Following the appearance of a bright white dot over the land, the island shook in response to [[Shuffles]]' announcement, even as the Eternal waited a day's trip away.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Gray [[Island]] is a destination featuring seamless gray [[stone]] docks and an untamed wilderness filled with hidden tunnels, clearings, and a [[labyrinth]] constructed by [[Jorin Curse-breaker]]. The land serves as a base for [[Architects]] and is home to two thousand [[Consultants]], many of whom lack family names. While the island contains an infirmary, vaults of [[goldmarks]], and a hidden high-status prison where [[Urzaia Woodsman]]'s wife is held, it is also a place where the [[Heart of Nakothi]] can be restrained and Bastion's Shadow{{!}}Bastion’s Shadow can reach. Although absolute silence characterizes the island at night, a monstrosity looms over the trees at its center, and it is a location where [[Shera]] and Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten engage in combat. Ultimately, the island remains a place of concealment where [[Champions]], [[Great Elders]], and even an [[assassin]] can be found under the bright sun.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Shrouded in a constant twilight, the Gray [[Island]] is a land of mystery, danger, and secrets that houses endless catacombs and a foundation of interconnected tunnels. The island is inhabited exclusively by [[Consultants]], though the [[Gardeners]] are sent there to perform labor for them while [[Architects]] work to keep the landscape looking pristine and natural. Within this environment, which includes the [[House of the Masons]] and various traps, Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine once served as a prisoner and [[Ayana]] was left under the island's care. [[Shera]] occasionally visits the location for training and has been tasked with its defense, finding it a place where she need not worry about common thieves. Following Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin's arrival shortly before [[Shera]]'s acquaintance with him, a group eventually planned to evacuate the island.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The lost Gray [[Island]] is a fortified location containing various vaults and the headquarters of the [[Masons]]. While it serves as a place for the [[Regents]] to rest, it is also home to the Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild headquarters and ancient secrets that may be under the [[Consultants]]' control. Although the island features a main [[stone]] dock alongside several smaller docks for clandestine departures, it is a place where gardeners do not exist, even though baby [[Gardeners]] were once pulled from its prisons. Despite the island's great defenses and Zhen of the Masons{{!}}Zhen's ability to monitor almost any event occurring there, Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin ultimately chose not to blight the entire landmass.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Gray Island]] has been lost.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Gray Island]] contains vaults.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has spent barely a handful of nights on the [[Gray Island]] since killing the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Gray Island]] may be under [[Consultant]] control.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Gray Island]] contains the Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild headquarters and ancient secrets.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Gray Island]] possesses great defenses.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Zhen of the Masons{{!}}Zhen can find out almost anything that happens on the [[Gray Island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The baby [[Gardeners]] were pulled out of the [[Gray Island]] prisons.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] are resting on the [[Gray Island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Gray Island]] is a location where gardeners do not exist.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Gray Island]] has a main [[stone]] dock and many smaller docks for clandestine departure.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Gray Island]] is a location where the [[Masons]]' headquarters are located.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] are the only ones on [[Gray Island]] who don't have to risk their necks.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin chose not to blight the entire [[Gray Island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“It’s called the Gray Island,” Andel finally said. “It’s north and east.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“He wants us to go to the Gray Island and wait,” Calder said.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“We also need the Gray Island back. There’s more to it than just the Consultant’s Guild headquarters.”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}
